name: – Anna Cavazzini – Draft Council decision
title: RECOMMENDATION on the draft Council decision on the conclusion, on behalf of the European Union, of the United Nations Convention on Transparency in Treaty-based Investor-State Arbitration
part_text:
The European Parliament agrees that the EU should sign a United Nations agreement on transparency in investor-state disputes. Under many old investment treaties, cases brought by companies against countries can stay secret from start to finish. The new rules make documents public, open hearings to the public, and let civil society groups submit their views. The agreement applies these rules to around 1,200 older treaties, including the Energy Charter Treaty, without renegotiating each one.

- Older investment treaties must now follow open-document and open-hearing rules.
- Companies and EU governments in disputes under those treaties are affected.
- The EU can now formally join the agreement; Parliament has given its consent.
